name: UtilVox
tagline: UtilVox is a premium, 100% free web utility ecosystem with over 170 tools designed for developers, designers, and everyday productivity
description: UtilVox is a premium, 100% free web utility ecosystem with over 170 tools designed for developers, designers, and everyday productivity. Built on Next.js and WebAssembly (WASM), all calculations, file conversions, and media modifications execute locally inside your browser's sandboxed cache. Your private data never touches a remote server.
